acip: ,GANG ZAG BDEN GRUB 'GOG PA'I RIGS PA'I RNAM GRANGS MTHA' YAS PA'I SHES RAB MI SKYED KYANG, NYON MONGS KYI SA BON GYI GNYEN PO RDZOGS PAR SGOM PA YOD LA, SHES BYA'I SGRIB PA'I GNYEN PO RDZOGS PAR SGOM PA NI MED DO,,
wylie: gang zag bden grub 'gog pa'i rigs pa'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa'i shes rab mi skyed kyang, nyon mongs kyi sa bon gyi gnyen po rdzogs par sgom pa yod la, shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po rdzogs par sgom pa ni med do
english: It is not the case that these individuals are able to give rise to that wisdom where we used literally countless forms of reasoning to block the idea that the person could exist in some real way. Nonetheless, they do possess a practice where they are able to meditate, in full, upon the antidotes for the seeds of the negative emotions. At the same time, they do not possess a practice where they can meditate, in a complete way, upon the the antidotes to the obstacles to omniscience.
